rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=120, pretrain_patience=120, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=400, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). THE V1 BREAKOUT KNOB, never tried on v2. ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3->1 (base=iter-5, the best SSIM 0.7294 @train_n=400/pretrain_epochs=120). All else identical to iter-5 (unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False KEPT, pretrain_lr=1e-4, pretrain_epochs=120, train_n=400, val_n=214, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); only max_train_s 1100 (18.3-min HARD backstop, safe because k=1 CUTS the per-sample DC cost to a third so this runs FASTER than iter-5 1410s). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr0 @ep12/tn200/k3 170s; iter-2 0.5888 @ep48 345s; iter-3 0.6230 @ep144 744s; iter-4 0.7039 @ep240 1237s; iter-5 0.7294/hr0 @ep120/tn400/k3 1411s (val_psnr 26.87); iter-6 0.6307 @ep144/tn200/k3 (tn revert). MAPPED KNOBS: pretrain_epochs (1->4, diminishing) and train_n coverage (5: +0.0255) -- BOTH at itnet_k=3 the WHOLE time. itnet_k has NEVER been moved off 3. (2) LIMITER: iter-3..6 declared a structural cap but did so while leaving the SINGLE highest-value family-proven lever UNPROBED. The k=3 DC re-projects through the noisy 2304-view adjoint 3x per sample, pulling the denoised image BACK toward the noisy LD-FBP -- OVER-APPLIED fixed DC DEGRADES the recon. The limiter is OVER-APPLIED DC steps, not under-training. (3) ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3->1. The v1 SIBLING under THIS campaign+metric proved it: itnet_k 3->1 unlocked hr 0->0.3752 (now #3 board, SSIM 0.9377 @k1/ep125/tn300); the trained denoiser + a SINGLE DC step is the sweet spot, the over-applied 3-step fixed-DC was degrading it. itnet_v2 already has a well-converged denoiser (SSIM 0.7294 SURVIVES under k=3 corruption) -- unwrapping 2 of the 3 corrupting DC steps should let that denoiser show through. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if itnet_k 3->1, val_ssim jumps PAST the 0.81 LD-FBP floor and hr CLEARS 0 (toward the v1 0.93/hr0.37 band), because a single trained-denoiser+1-DC pass on the per-sample-ps FBP is the family sweet spot and removes the over-applied-DC degradation. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays <=~0.75 (no jump past 0.81 floor) and hr=0 at k=1, then v2 (pretrain-then-FIXED-DC, log_alpha never trained) genuinely caps below the floor regardless of DC depth -- DISTINCT from v1 whose DC was effectively trainable end-to-end -- and the structural-cap verdict stands; iter-8 would document the ceiling. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s). k=1 cuts the per-sample val DC ops 3->1 (line 94 for _ in range(k)) while pretrain (no DC) is unchanged; iter-5 1411s was dominated by k=3 val + ep120/tn400 pretrain, so k=1 lands WELL under 1200s. max_train_s=1100 backstop leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure inside the 30-min wall. val_n=214 KEPT, grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (itnet.projector swap, bs=1+val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px geometry FOV (no fov= override). residual_learning=False KEPT.
